question: Which recovery contract should shared Periphery use when a failed-jobs-only retry reruns only one producer: cross-attempt artifact resolution per producer, or mandatory paired producer reruns?
rationale: Both choices can be valid, but they differ in artifact-retention and retry semantics; the current single-attempt naming contract cannot safely support the PR's claimed one-sided recovery path.

options.title: Resolve artifacts per producer
options.body: Update the intersection to locate each producer's latest valid artifact and prove a rerun where only one producer executes on attempt 2.

options.title: Require paired producer recovery
options.body: Redesign the shared scan recovery so a retry reruns both producers together before the intersection consumes artifacts.

recommendation.title: Resolve artifacts per producer
recommendation.body: Update the intersection to locate each producer's latest valid artifact and prove a rerun where only one producer executes on attempt 2.
